name.value: Gina Guu Aahljuu Naay Performance House

description.value: The Gina Guu Aahljuu Naay (Performance House) is one of several traditional longhouse-style buildings within the award-winning Haida Heritage Centre at Ḵay Llnagaay in Skidegate, Haida Gwaii. The 50,000 sq ft Centre celebrates the living culture of the Haida people through art, language, and stories in a complex designed to resemble a traditional oceanside Haida village. Reaching Haida Gwaii requires a ferry from Prince Rupert or a flight to Sandspit, making the Centre a destination highlight for cyclists who make the journey.
